name: DARPA Lift Challenge Official Results
known_limitations: DARPA's August 11 official results name the measured objective-category ratios, award winners, and prize decisions. Only five teams completed scored runs, and the release does not establish certified service, production scale, recurring operation, or deployed military or commercial outcomes.
automation_notes: The August 23 bounded check resolved the measured-results gate using DARPA's August 11 official results release. Monitor only for later official maturation, transition, production, certification, or operational evidence; do not infer those outcomes from the competition awards.
